title: Zoning text change for 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Queens
summary: This application would amend the Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens. It works together with a related zoning map change to allow a new seven-story mixed-use building with 54 apartments, including 13 income-restricted units. The City Council approved the change, with modifications, on July 14, 2026.
